name: Authentication Middleware
description: Adds multiple OpenID Connect and trusted reverse-proxy identities with explicit Cove account linking and local permission control.
author: MidnightRider

externalDependencies.name: OpenID Connect provider
externalDependencies.description: Required only when OIDC login is enabled. The Cove backend and browser must both reach the configured issuer.
externalDependencies.installHint: Configure an Authorization Code provider with PKCE and an exact Cove callback URI.
externalDependencies.dockerHint: Run the identity provider on a host reachable from both the browser and the Cove container.

externalDependencies.name: Authenticated reverse proxy
externalDependencies.description: Required only for trusted-header mode. It must authenticate requests, remove client-supplied identity headers, and set one canonical stable-subject header plus optional display metadata.
externalDependencies.installHint: Keep Cove's direct upstream private and trust only the proxy's narrow direct-peer IP or CIDR.
externalDependencies.dockerHint: If the proxy is containerized, give it explicit network paths to Cove and the authentication outpost.
